about.title: Method
about.lead: Hunika compares selling today with storing for 1 to 4 months. It uses the range of past years, and it recommends storage only when the likely gain is clear and the bad case is small. Every number is tested on past harvests in Proof.
about.notice: Advice based on past prices, not a guarantee.
about.wfp: WFP retail prices, via HDX, downloaded 25 October 2026. Newest month in the file: August 2026.
about.cpi: NISR rural food CPI through September 2026, published 10 October 2026.
about.sas: NISR Seasonal Agricultural Survey district tables, Seasons A and B, 2018 to 2026. Newest: Season B 2026, published 22 September 2026.
about.ahs: Agricultural Household Survey 2024 is not in the app yet. It has to be downloaded from the NISR microdata catalog.

about.team: Shima Serein, for the NISR 2026 Big Data Hackathon. All rights in the submission pass to NISR.
about.ai: AI use: the code, the data pipeline and the first drafts of the text were written with Claude, an AI assistant, from the team's build guide. Every figure comes from the sources listed here.
about.ahsUsed: NISR Agricultural Household Survey 2024 ({n} sampled households): about {households} thousand Eastern Province households grow maize or beans. Median Season A harvest: {maize} kg of maize, {beans} kg of beans. {coop} belong to a cooperative; {markets} of members say it markets their crop, but only {storage} get storage from it. {loan} asked for a loan, and buying food was the most common reason. The survey has no question on crop sales, storage or losses, so the loss rates come from published trials.
